description: Get information about Jenkins builds with Jenkins REST API.

parameters.name: build_number
parameters.description: An integer which specifies a build of a job. If not specified the last build information is returned.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the Jenkins job to which the build belongs.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: API token used to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL of the Jenkins server. Default: "http://localhost:8080"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

examples:
- name: Get information about a jenkins build using basic authentication
  community.general.jenkins_build_info:
    name: "test-check"
    build_number: 1
    user: admin
    password: asdfg
    url: http://localhost:8080

- name: Get information about a jenkins build anonymously
  community.general.jenkins_build_info:
    name: "stop-check"
    build_number: 3
    url: http://localhost:8080

- name: Get information about a jenkins build using token authentication
  community.general.jenkins_build_info:
    name: "delete-experiment"
    build_number: 30
    user: Jenkins
    token: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456
    url: http://localhost:8080

return_values.name: build_info
return_values.description: Build info of the jenkins job. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the jenkins job. Returned: success Sample: "test-job"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the jenkins job. Returned: success Sample: "present"

return_values.name: url
return_values.description: URL to connect to the Jenkins server. Returned: success Sample: "https://jenkins.mydomain.com"

return_values.name: user
return_values.description: User used for authentication. Returned: success Sample: "admin"
